question: Why did we pause new Beacon editor work, and who signed off?
answer: New work on the Beacon editor was paused in September 2026, after a DACI weighed three options and chose to pause and maintain. The DACI names Amara Lindqvist as approver, and was marked Approved on Sep 15, 2026. The question was reopened in October, and no new decision has been recorded yet.
